About Sadguru Industrial Enterprises

Sadguru Industrial Enterprises started in 2011 in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh. The firm is run by its proprietor, Rohit Srivastava, and makes insulation components for distribution and power transformers.

Over 15 years we have built a simple reputation: parts that match the drawing, delivered on time, at a fair price. Our customers are transformer manufacturers and electricity utilities who need a steady supply of pressboard strips, dovetail spacers, hardwood rods, bakelite strips, Permawood parts and complete insulation kits.

What we do

  • Cut pressboard strips and dovetail spacers to size from electrical-grade pressboard
  • Turn hardwood rods in diameters from 6 mm to 16 mm
  • Cut F4-grade bakelite (phenolic laminate) strips
  • Machine Permawood / transformer-wood components to drawing
  • Assemble complete insulation kits per transformer rating
  • Make press-paper clack bands for power transformers
